description: «Продолжить поиск»: a finished or stopped search goes on for `more` more leads with the same requirements (no new brief). SPENDS CREDITS: quote_search(leads=more) first, show the price, and after the user's yes pass its credits_high as confirm_credits. Returns at once; poll get_search. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/more]

confirm_credits.description: The price in credits the matching quote returned, shown to the user and confirmed by them.

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: continue_search
title: Find more leads (spends credits)
